name: Dev-Tool FB Creative Pack
description: An N-creative (typically 30+) static Facebook / Meta / IG ad pack for a SaaS / dev-tool startup, built as a 5-set creative matrix: A real-people testimonial portraits, B graphic / typography posters, C proof / data-viz (charts, code cards, dashboards), D meme formats, E niche-audience hooks. The whole pack reads on-brand because of two pre-flight disciplines: site-grounding (curl the live site's CSS for the REAL hex palette + Playwright-screenshot the hero, NEVER sketch brand-DNA from memory) and --ref discipline (pass that hero screenshot as --ref on every single gen so palette + type drift across 30+ distinct concepts goes to zero). Each set has a per-set prompt formula - photoreal testimonial portrait (Sony A7 IV + Sigma 85mm + Kodak Portra + named imperfection + naturalistic NOT glossy), strikethrough-price stack, horizontal bar chart, macOS-chrome code card, meme header. Baked on openai/gpt-5.4-image-2 in TRUE parallel (the 1-concurrent cap is a stale myth - probe it). Copy ships alongside as ads-copy.md (primary text + headline + description + CTA per creative).
referenceNotes: No AI-gen refs needed up front. The brand's live site IS the reference: Playwright-screenshot the hero to refs/hero.png and pass it as --ref on every gen. That single hero ref is what holds palette + type across 30+ distinct concepts.

slots.description: The live site to ground against (CSS palette + hero screenshot source).
Brand HEX tokens pulled from the site CSS (not from memory). CTA color, win-color, ink, bg.
Playwright hero screenshot of the live site, passed as --ref on EVERY gen for brand consistency.
The hard numbers from the lander (accuracy %, price, speed) that anchor the punchy headlines.
The documented API shape (curl / SDK / GUI) — code creatives MUST show what the site documents, not an invented SDK.
Which of the 5 sets to run: A real-people, B graphic, C proof, D meme, E niche. Default all 5.

doNotCopyLiterally: Site-ground BEFORE writing brand-DNA: curl the site CSS for the real hex palette + Playwright-screenshot the hero. Pass that hero as --ref on every gen. Verify every named API symbol against the site/docs OR fall back to curl (which always exists for an HTTP API) - never render an invented `import <brand>` SDK. Generate in TRUE parallel via `for slot; do ralphy generate image ... & done; wait` (the 1-concurrent cap is a stale myth - probe it with 2 cheap gens). Never --force-overwrite on regen.
stackSummary: openai/gpt-5.4-image-2 only ($0.20/image, --size 1080x1350) - typography-grade for headlines, code cards, percentages, strikethrough pricing, and photoreal portraits. TRUE parallel (no real concurrency cap). curl + Playwright for site-grounding ($0). No video/VO/music/render. ~$8.0 for a 32-pack (~$6.4 if site-grounded from turn 1).
